| RSI             | Tendency of the water                               | Action                                                            |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 7.6 < RSI < 9.0 | Strong corrosion                                    | Regular control necessary, use of corrosion inhibitor recommended |
| 9.1 <RSI<11     | Very strong corrosion                               | Regular control necessary, use of corrosion inhibitor required    |
| RSI > 11        | Very strong corrosion in the complete water circuit | Water should not be used                                          |
